title: Counter-Selector Wave 18: repair continuation, learning custody, and identity-block audit
purpose: Audit the strongest live person traces for post-contradiction repair continuation and custody; retest both unresolved identity blocks against the acquired official record; and generate identity-label-removed external-review exports without sending a request, contacting a source subject, increasing the denominator, ranking people, or authorizing a field test.

new_support_assignments.basis: The official NASA history states that McDonald headed Morton Thiokol's parallel redesign group, argued for a test orientation capable of simulating flight stresses, and remained in the redesign-and-test sequence as failed or ambiguous tests forced changes to the baseline design.
new_support_assignments.ceiling: Leadership in one repair programme does not establish sole authorship, control of every design decision, safe successor handoff, or capability outside the shuttle solid-rocket-motor domain.

new_support_assignments.basis: The official history places McDonald at the head of the contractor redesign group through an extensive test programme and records his direct inspection of the still-smoking final full-scale booster for joint failure before return-to-flight qualification.
new_support_assignments.ceiling: Redesign and test-verification custody is not an independently resumable handoff receipt, sole custody of the programme, or proof that later operators could continue from an attributable McDonald-authored state package.

observed_support: a parallel Morton Thiokol redesign group
joint NASA-contractor engineering and test resources
congressional and NASA pressure restoring a central role

new_support_assignments.basis: NASA's Technical Reports Server attributes to Rocha a public accident case study that preserves Columbia communication-breakdown and risk-management lessons as a source-addressable learning object; NASA's lessons-learned system describes reviewed lessons as inputs to training, best practices, and policy work.
new_support_assignments.ceiling: Authorship and public custody of a post-incident learning object do not establish in-flight decision custody, recipient adoption, effective organizational transfer, or an independent handoff that another operator used to resume the original mission object.

observed_support: NASA Technical Reports Server publication custody

person_updates.non_advance_reason: The new repair-continuation record attributes redesign leadership and final verification to McDonald and a wider team; it does not supply a Boisjoly handoff receipt, redesign-custody receipt, transfer artifact, or support comparator.
No new official object in this wave isolates audit authorship, complete board response, departure merits, or an independent office handoff; officeholder publication custody remains the ceiling.

required_objects: original hazard report or safety-submission object
author and recipient metadata for the relevant warning
